name: local-ssh-deploy
description: Publish the current local project to a user-specified server through confirmation-gated SSH deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Publish the current project through your local SSH client.
interface.longDescription: Packages the current local project, uploads it with the local OpenSSH client, and runs an explicit deployment command only after a dry run and user confirmation. Private key contents are never accepted or read.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this local site to my server over SSH.
Dry-run an SSH deployment of the current project.
Publish this project using my SSH key path and deploy command.
